WHAT IS KERATIN HAIR TREATMENT? 

If you're searching for professional keratin treatments in Manhattan, NYC, Luxe Aura Hair Extensions offers customized treatments designed to smooth frizz, improve manageability, and enhance your hair's appearance. During the treatment, our professional hairstylists apply a keratin-based formula to the hair to help create a smoother, shinier finish. Results may vary depending on your hair type, condition, and aftercare routine. Contact our NYC salon to learn more about keratin treatments and schedule your appointment.

how long do salons for Keratin Treatments in NYC last?

Typically, anywhere from 4 -6 months depending on the after care. This means, the types of shampoos and conditioners you use along with how frequently you wash your hair and even how much you sweat can affect the overall time your keratin treatment will last.

How to make keratin treatments last?

Naturally, this follow up question comes after wanting to know how long keratin treatments last. By Simply using hydrating, sulfate free shampoos and conditioners at every shampoo and avoiding excessive swimming and sweating your keratin should last longer especially during warm months. These steps will ensure maximum results.

TOP KERATIN TREATMENT IN NEW YORK, NY

Looking for professional keratin treatments in Manhattan, NYC? Luxe Aura Hair Extensions offers customized keratin treatments designed to reduce frizz, improve hair manageability, and create a smoother, shinier finish. Our experienced hairstylists tailor each treatment to your hair's length, thickness, texture, and condition, helping make everyday styling and blow-drying easier. Keratin treatments in NYC start at around $250, with final pricing depending on your hair's individual needs. Same-day keratin treatment appointments may be available, subject to availability. Contact our Manhattan salon to schedule your consultation or appointment.

items.title: What is a keratin hair treatment?
items.html: Keratin treatment is a smoothing process where keratin protein is applied to repair damaged hair, reduce frizz, and improve shine.

items.title: How does keratin treatment work?
items.html: It fills in damaged and porous areas of the hair, making it smoother, healthier, and more manageable.

items.title: How long does a keratin treatment last?
items.html: Keratin treatments typically last 4 to 6 months, depending on aftercare and hair type.

items.title: How can I make my keratin treatment last longer?
items.html: Use sulfate-free shampoos, avoid excessive washing, and limit exposure to chlorine, sweat, and humidity.

items.title: How much does a keratin treatment cost in NYC?
items.html: Keratin treatments usually start at around $250+, depending on hair length, thickness, and texture.

items.title: What are the benefits of a keratin treatment?
items.html: It reduces frizz, adds shine, improves manageability, and cuts down styling and blow-drying time.
